scope: Factual monthly regime chronology for Task04 stage1, no individual treatment or causal identification

events.facts: Reduced grant rates from 1 January 2023; only battery/fuel-cell vehicles remain eligible. Amounts vary by category; no uniform EUR dose is assigned.
events.announcement_limitation: Current annual review is primary evidence of the effective rule, not a verified dated 2022 announcement.

events.facts: From September 2023 only private persons may apply; annual review documents elevated August applications. Monthly step, not a manufacturer-specific incentive.
events.announcement_limitation: No exact historical publication timestamp established; dates not invented.

events.facts: No new applications after this cutoff; 17 December was the final application day. December is a mixed transition month; January 2024 first full post-end month.
events.announcement_limitation: The stated 13 December KTF decision is not relabelled a public announcement.

events.facts: Private qualifying households, purchase/leasing new first-registered domestic M1; BEV EUR3000 base, income/children increments up to EUR6000; income ceiling and vehicle criteria apply. PHEV values differ. Retroactive eligibility is not prior public knowledge.

model_mapping.portal_sensitivity: 2026-05 step replaces 2026-01, not an additional simultaneous coefficient
model_mapping.tax: No additional constant BEV tax indicator; collinear with intercept; historical amendment not identified here.

known_information_limits: 2023 effective rules are retrospective historical design, not reconstructed contemporaneous release vintages. All rolling origins begin December 2024, after those rules. Future 2026 grant disabled before 19 January 2026 announcement.
